news.headline: Russian attack on Ukrainian city kills 15, a day after Trump eases diesel sanctions on Moscow
news.summary: Fifteen people, including three children, were killed in a Russian attack on the southern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia on Saturday, a day after US President Donald Trump announced a deal to lift sanctions on Russian diesel, in a major setback for Kyiv.
